decisions.reason: As a core finishing machine close to the firm's long-established offer, it likely remains in the range to cover less automated customer segments despite some risk of overlap with newer automation-focused models.
A fully automatic perfect binder fits the firm's stated direction toward automation, productivity, and digital print finishing, so it is likely to stay on the market.
The booklet maker supports commercial and digital print workflows and complements the firm's broad finishing portfolio, with no clear sign that it underperformed enough to justify withdrawal.
